ACTIONABLE REJECTION. No repository files were changed and no commit was manufactured. Reviewed committed HEAD 5a8b0c97c160be8f5b876617952be023c6e9be97 without consulting another implementation. ADR-023 has Decision items rather than numbered §§3.2/4.1/4.4; its Decision items 2-5, ADR-024 Decision items 1-5, and normative secret-ruleset-v4 §§3.2, 4.1, 4.4, with §§3.3, 3.4, and 4.5, were the governing references.

Findings: §3.2 clearly defines raw and normalized membership, explicit normalized escape/percent transforms, dewrapped source, decoded source from normalized input, one-level intent from ADR-024 Decision 4/Rationale, and limits of 64 runs per field/65,536 bytes per run. It does not define line-terminator variants, the exact union alphabet, first-64 left-to-right selection, independent-run/slot semantics, over-limit skip versus truncate behavior, invalid-decoding handling, or complete lenient-base64 grammar. §3.4 says smallest raw range and whole-run decoded range but does not make half-open envelope/mapping invariants precise. These gaps can cause missed later/over-limit credentials and divergent fingerprints/redaction selectors.

§4.1/§4.5 make direct JWT blocking normative for three >=8-byte [A-Za-z0-9_-] segments with first two beginning eyJ, only when the first segment decodes to a JSON object containing alg. A fresh synthetic JWT had segments 36/26/16, shape=true, header_alg=true, intended block; the same-shape no-alg case was intended checksum_failed/advisory. A one-level base64url(JWT) probe had a 107-byte encoded run and 80 printable decoded bytes, but decoded-run selection/grammar gaps prevent cross-implementation determinism. §3.3 correctly limits decoded matching to provider/private-key rules.

§4.4 has an unambiguous positive for `-token  <40-byte alternating value>`: Q(value,20) was true (len=40, alnum=40, digits=20, word_run_bytes=0, transitions=39), so that exact marked row is intended to block. The literal form requires a marker; unmarked `token  <value>` is not a Form 3 row. `|token|<value>|` is ambiguous because `|` is allowed by Value but also an optional delimiter, and `| token | <value> |` is not guaranteed because post-marker whitespace is unspecified. Table-row blocking is therefore only partially normative.

Supplied research/fixtures/secret-write-boundary-v1.json is not a v4 truth fixture: jq identity/schema validation passed, all 9 cases were present with expected outcomes direct-service-create reject-before-commit, direct-service-comment reject-before-commit, manifest-late-operation all-or-none-reject, recovered-template-materialize reject-generated-text, managed-mode-downgrade fail-closed, managed-acknowledgment fail-closed, recovery-local-finding local-success-publication-quarantined, quarantined-flush refuse, and redacted-recovery publish-sanitized-generation; the decoded/JWT/table-row marker scan found none. It cannot discharge this review.
